SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, 
  ROUND(AVG(yt * 1.0 / (anglers + anglers)), 2) as avg_share_naive
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 30 AND 60 AND avail_t <= 60.875
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, total_yt DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT DISTINCT fish_date_season FROM trips LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) as count, MIN(fish_date_doy) as min_doy, MAX(fish_date_doy) as max_doy 
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND avail_t <= 60.875

SELECT fish_date_season, MIN(fish_date_doy) as min_doy, MAX(fish_date_doy) as max_doy, COUNT(*) as trip_count
FROM trips WHERE avail_t <= 60.875
GROUP BY fish_date_season ORDER BY fish_date_season

SELECT fish_date_season, COUNT(*) as trip_count, MIN(fish_date_doy) as min_doy, MAX(fish_date_doy) as max_doy
FROM trips GROUP BY fish_date_season ORDER BY fish_date_season

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, SUM(yt) as total_yt, ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip
FROM trips WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 30 AND 60
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, avg_yt_per_trip DESC

SELECT ts_doy, ROUND(AVG(wtmp_c), 1) as avg_wtmp_c, MIN(wtmp_c) as min_temp, MAX(wtmp_c) as max_temp
FROM pier WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy BETWEEN 30 AND 60
GROUP BY ts_doy ORDER BY ts_doy DESC LIMIT 31
